name: picoclaw
description: U-Claw Lite kernel: frozen third-party PicoClaw Go binary (MIT).
notes: sha256 covers the release zip; binary_sha256 covers the extracted picoclaw.exe. Both are verified by setup.ps1 without executing the binary.
Version freeze: bumping a version requires re-verifying both hashes from the upstream release; never edit hashes by hand.
Windows x64 only; see CONTRIBUTING.md scope for what is not supported now.
